content: {"episode_id":"ep-05000","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"The patient has recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction, the clinical indication note states that continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to characterize arrhythmia burden and guide anticoagulation management. We request reconsideration of the denial for mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) based on these documented clinical indications, while acknowledging that the required prior authorization was missing."}
